result.workflow:
This is a bounded discussion, not an implementation mission. Use only the advertised mesh communication tools; leave files unchanged and do not run commands or other agents.
Use the roadmap as the discussion topic. Send one substantive question or proposal to discussionPartner; keep each message under 80 words. Each peer has one partner so every participant both asks and answers without broadcast chatter.
Handle messages already included in join. Use mesh_poll with waitMs=20000 when waiting for mail. Reply to each incoming request with state=completed and its deliveryId to acknowledge it atomically. Include a reasoned answer, not just agreement.
A terminal answer to your own request needs mesh_ack, not another reply. Batch deliveryIds when appropriate. Reuse a messageId only when replaying the exact same message.
Finish after your outgoing request has a terminal answer that you acknowledged and you answered your incoming request. Record one mesh_checkpoint with your conclusion and the task/message IDs supporting it; omit the checkpoint id for a new record.
Call mesh_yield, copy its workRevision to final work_revision, and exit idle with a concise handoff. This closes your discussion contribution; it does not assert implementation-mission acceptance.
